decisions.reason: As a close cutting-and-creasing extension with low carrying cost and no visible negative signal after two years, its option value still exceeds the case for withdrawal.

The UV spot varnishing system remains riskier because it is more distant from the core range, but its strategic adjacency to print enhancement and prior flagship status justify keeping the option open a bit longer.
The sheet preparation module fits existing finishing workflows and can be maintained at low incremental cost, so management would wait for further demand resolution rather than exit now.
The B2 multifinisher is tightly aligned with the firm's automation-oriented direction and core portfolio, making early abandonment unlikely absent a clear failure signal.
The hybrid saddle stitcher stays within the firm's familiar booklet-making domain and is cheap to retain in a broad portfolio, so there is still more value in continuing than in dropping it.
